name: High Tide
role: Payoff / ritual engine — the archetype's namesake; doubles Island mana for a turn
text: Until end of turn, whenever a player taps an Island for mana, that player adds an additional {U}.
note: Namesake payoff. Islands-matter ritual; fuels free-spell chains.

name: Sea's Claim
role: Islands-maker — own-ramp + opponent land-denial (turn a dual into a mono Island)
text:
Enchant land
Enchanted land is an Island.
note: Cheapest permanent Islands-maker. In-block (ONS). Ramp or denial.

name: Spreading Seas
role: Islands-maker + cantrip — best denial enabler (replaces itself)
text:
Enchant land
When this Aura enters, draw a card.
Enchanted land is an Island.
note: Cantrip Islands-maker. Strands opp off colors; ramps you.

name: Convincing Mirage
role: Flexible type-changer — Island for you / off-color denial vs opponent
text:
Enchant land
As this Aura enters, choose a basic land type.
Enchanted land is the chosen type.
note: Choose Island for ramp, or strand opponent's nonbasic.

name: Lingering Mirage
role: Islands-maker with cycling — flexible (denial enabler or pitch late)
text:
Enchant land
Enchanted land is an Island.
Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)
note: Islands-maker that cycles if you don't need the lock.

name: Phantasmal Terrain
role: Type-changer — old-school denial (strand a basic) or own Island
text:
Enchant land
As this Aura enters, choose a basic land type.
Enchanted land is the chosen type.
note: Properly-old denial. Redundant with Convincing Mirage; surplus.

name: Aquitect's Will
role: Cheap flood-counter Islands-maker — repeatable denial vector via counter
text: Put a flood counter on target land. That land is an Island in addition to its other types for as long as it has a flood counter on it. If you control a Merfolk, draw a card.
note: Flood-counter Island; additive (keeps mana online for you).

name: Quicksilver Fountain
role: Slow Islands-lock engine — grinds every land to Island; classic prison piece
text: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player puts a flood counter on target non-Island land they control of their choice. That land is an Island for as long as it has a flood counter on it. At the beginning of each end step, if all lands on the battlefield are Islands, remove all flood counters from them.
note: Colorless flood engine; locks foes off colors, fuels High Tide.

name: Celestial Dawn
role: All-your-lands-Plains fixer — listed enabler; off-axis (Plains not Island)
text: Lands you control are Plains. Nonland permanents you control are white. The same is true for spells you control and nonland cards you own that aren't on the battlefield. You may spend white mana as though it were mana of any color. You may spend other mana only as though it were colorless mana.
note: Brief named enabler but makes Plains, anti-synergy w/High Tide. Weak include.

name: Sunken City
role: Listed enabler — but is actually a blue-creature anthem w/ upkeep cost
text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this enchantment unless you pay {U}{U}. Blue creatures get +1/+1.
[ERRATA: also makes lands you control Islands while it remains.]
note: Real text is +1/+1 anthem, NOT Islands. Needs errata to fit theme.

name: Tidal Warrior
role: Repeatable Island-maker body — denial/ramp engine on a stick
text: {T}: Target land becomes an Island until end of turn.
note: Out-exception: rare repeatable Islands-maker creature for the theme.

name: Harbinger of the Seas
role: Static mass Islands-lock body — all nonbasics become Islands (denial keystone)
text: Nonbasic lands are Islands.
note: Out-exception: turns every nonbasic into an Island; strong prison key.

name: Frantic Search
role: Free spell — net-zero mana with 3 Islands+High Tide; loots + storm count
text: Draw two cards, then discard two cards. Untap up to three lands.
note: Effectively free under High Tide; dig + storm fuel.

name: Snap
role: Free bounce — untaps 2 lands; tempo + free storm-count under High Tide
text: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Untap up to two lands.
note: Free tempo bounce; resets ETBs, pads storm.

name: Turnabout
role: Big mana burst — untap all your lands (net mana w/ High Tide) or tap-down lock
text: Choose artifact, creature, or land. Tap all untapped permanents of the chosen type target player controls, or untap all tapped permanents of that type that player controls.
note: Untap-lands ritual engine; also a tempo tap-down lock.

name: Rewind
role: Free counter — untaps 4 lands; mana-neutral countermagic for the deck
text: Counter target spell. Untap up to four lands.
note: Effectively-free counter; refunds its own cost via untap.

name: Unwind
role: Free counter (noncreature) — untaps 3 lands; protects the combo turn
text: Counter target noncreature spell. Untap up to three lands.
note: Mana-neutral noncreature counter; combo protection.

name: Reset
role: Untap-all-lands ritual — huge mana burst with High Tide (Reserved-adjacent jank)
text: Cast this spell only during an opponent's turn after their upkeep step. Untap all lands you control.
note: Untap all lands; explosive w/ High Tide. Opp-turn restriction.

name: Cloud of Faeries
role: Free creature — untaps 2 lands, cycles; the canonical free-spell body
note: Out-exception: iconic free flyer; refunds mana, cycles if dead.

name: Peregrine Drake
role: Net-positive mana body — untaps 5 lands; flying clock; combo with flicker
text:
Flying
When this creature enters, untap up to five lands.
note: Out-exception: net +mana w/ High Tide; honest single-body, no auto-loop.

name: Great Whale
role: Big untap-7-lands body — top-end mana refund; honest one-shot (no bounce loop)
text: When this creature enters, untap up to seven lands.
note: Out-exception: Palinchron without self-bounce, so safe at low power.

name: Merchant Scroll
role: Tutor — fetches High Tide / Brain Freeze / a free spell; consistency glue
text: Search your library for a blue instant card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
note: Finds High Tide, Brain Freeze, Snap, Turnabout. Combo glue.

name: Mystic Speculation
role: Buyback scry-3 — repeatable selection + storm-count padder under High Tide
text:
Buyback {2}
Scry 3.
note: Recurring cheap spell to set up + build storm count.

name: Whispers of the Muse
role: Buyback cantrip — recurring storm fodder + late-game card engine
text:
Buyback {5}
Draw a card.
note: Repeatable draw; cheap storm count once High Tide is up.

name: Capsize
role: Buyback bounce — grindy soft-lock (bounce a land each turn) + storm engine
text:
Buyback {3}
Return target permanent to its owner's hand.
note: Recurring bounce = soft prison; mana-hungry, fair at low power.

name: Brain Freeze
role: Storm mill payoff — the honest spent-on-a-spell win (deck the opponent)
text:
Target player mills three cards.
Storm
note: In-block (SCG) storm mill kill; honest stapled-to-spell wincon.

name: Stroke of Genius
role: Big-X mana sink — the High-Tide payoff; draw huge or deck-out opponent
text: Target player draws X cards.
note: Instant-speed X-draw payoff; can target opp to deck them.

name: Braingeyser
role: Classic big-X draw — sorcery-speed High-Tide payoff / mana sink
text: Target player draws X cards.
note: Old-school X-draw payoff; redundant w/Stroke, surplus pick.

name: Blue Sun's Zenith
role: Recurring big-X draw — shuffles back; reusable mill-out / draw payoff
text: Target player draws X cards. Shuffle Blue Sun's Zenith into its owner's library.
note: Reusable X-draw; can iteratively deck an opponent. UUU-heavy.

name: Laboratory Maniac
role: Shared alt-win — empty-library win for High Tide draw AND the Ad Nauseam package
text: If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead.
note: Out-exception: shared labman wincon (user spec #4). Never Thassa's Oracle.

name: Mana Severance
role: Lab Maniac enabler — strip all lands so a big draw decks YOU into the win
text: Search your library for any number of land cards, exile them, then shuffle.
note: Thins lands so Stroke/Braingeyser + Labman draws you out to win.

name: Sundial of the Infinite
role: Combo enabler — end turn to keep a Leveler/Mana Severance empty library, fizzle triggers
text: {1}, {T}: End the turn. Activate only during your turn.
note: Per spec #13: Stifle-on-a-stick for Leveler empty-library wins; cross-package.

name: Leveler
role: Empty-library enabler — with Sundial/Labman, the non-Ad-Nauseam combo finish
text: When this creature enters, exile all cards from your library.
note: Out-exception (colorless artifact): Sundial fizzles its draw-block; Labman wins.

name: Mana Short
role: Tempo lock finisher — tap all opp lands + burn their mana; clears the combo turn
text: Tap all lands target player controls and that player loses all unspent mana.
note: Lock their mana for a turn; protects a storm or alpha turn.

name: Back to Basics
role: Prison piece — nonbasics don't untap; asymmetric vs greedy manabases
text: Nonbasic lands don't untap during their controllers' untap steps.
note: Soft mana prison; you run mostly Islands so it's one-sided.

name: Rising Waters
role: Stax-lite prison — one land per upkeep; throttles the table, you adapt around it
text: Lands don't untap during their controllers' untap steps. At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player untaps a land they control.
note: Symmetric land-lock; pairs with cheap free spells you can still cast.

name: Choke
role: Anti-mirror hate / Islands-prison turned outward — punishes Islands decks
text: Islands don't untap during their controllers' untap steps.
note: Hoses opp who got their lands turned to Islands; sideboard-y green hate.

name: Words of Wisdom
role: Cheap card flow + storm padder — in-block draw that feeds the engine
text: You draw two cards, then each other player draws a card.
note: In-block (ODY) cheap draw; nearly free under High Tide.

name: Careful Study
role: 1-mana loot — digs to High Tide / fills yard for Brain Freeze flashback turns
text: Draw two cards, then discard two cards.
note: In-block (ODY) cheap dig + cheap storm count.

name: Slipstream Eel
role: In-block Islands-matters body — cycles early, beats only into Island decks late
text:
This creature can't attack unless defending player controls an Island.
Cycling {1}{U}
note: In-block (ONS) Islands payoff; cycle early, finisher once you flood foe.

name: Shoreline Ranger
role: In-block flyer with Islandcycling — flexible Island-fetch or beater
text:
Flying
Islandcycling {2}
note: In-block (SCG); islandcycle to find an Island or play a 3/4 flyer.

name: Wonder
role: In-block Islands payoff — graveyard grants flying while you control an Island
text:
Flying
As long as this card is in your graveyard and you control an Island, creatures you control have flying.
note: In-block (JUD) Islands-matters; self-mill payoff, evasion enabler.

name: Dreamwinder
role: In-block Island-maker body — sac an Island to spread Islands; on-theme but slow
text:
This creature can't attack unless defending player controls an Island.
{U}, Sacrifice an Island: Target land becomes an Island until end of turn.
note: In-block (ODY) Islands engine + body; flavor-perfect, low power.

name: Glimpse the Unthinkable
role: Gold mill payoff — big chunk mill to pair with Brain Freeze deck-out plan
text: Target player mills ten cards.
note: Dimir mill payoff to back up Brain Freeze; possibly redundant.

name: Mind Funeral
role: Gold mill payoff — variable big mill; alternate Dimir deck-out angle
text: Target opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until four land cards are revealed. That player puts all cards revealed this way into their graveyard.
note: Dimir mill; surplus mill payoff alongside Brain Freeze.

name: Palinchron
role: EXCLUDED — infinite-mana engine; self-bounce + untap 7 loops with any mana doubler
text:
Flying
When this creature enters, untap up to seven lands.
{2}{U}{U}: Return this creature to its owner's hand.
note: REJECT: self-bounce loops to infinite mana w/High Tide. too_strong.

name: Time Spiral
role: EXCLUDED — untap-6-lands + refill hand; free 7-card draw engine, format-warper
text: Exile Time Spiral. Each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library, then draws seven cards. You untap up to six lands.
note: REJECT: near-free Timetwister + ritual; explosive combo enabler. too_strong.

name: Mind Over Matter
role: EXCLUDED — board-camping engine; untap-lands at will + draw engine = infinite
text: Discard a card: You may tap or untap target artifact, creature, or land.
note: REJECT: permanent that camps + goes infinite with draw. Violates honest-combo. too_strong.

name: Reality Spasm
role: Scalable untap — untap X lands as a flexible High-Tide ritual or tap-down
text: Choose one — Tap X target permanents.; Untap X target permanents.
note: Untap-X-lands ritual; flexible w/ High Tide, also a tempo tap.
